issues.explanation: Chapter 17 opens with Lü Bu wanting to kill Chen Gui and Chen Deng, although Chapter 16 just established Chen Deng as Lü Bu’s trusted inner agent who persuaded him to cooperate. The sudden reversal makes Lü Bu’s attitude and Chen Deng’s continued influence confusing.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a brief bridge explaining that Lü Bu’s suspicions of the Chen family resurfaced when Yuan Shu attacked, or that he threatened them while testing their loyalty; then show Chen Deng calming or redirecting him.
